description: Erection of a two-storey, self-contained dwellinghouse (Use Class C3) to the rear of 116 Culford Road, together with associated landscaping, cycle parking, and refuse storage and installation of an ASHP and PV panels.
decision_conditions: <p><span data-sheets-root="1" style="">The proposed development, by reason of lack of provision of affordable housing or affordable housing contribution, would fail to adequately contribute towards the provision of mixed and balanced communities and housing need in the local area. As such, the development would not be consistent with&nbsp;</span>paragraph 64 of the NPPF (2024),<span data-sheets-root="1">&nbsp;</span><span data-sheets-root="1">policy H4 (</span><span style="text-align: justify;">Delivering affordable housing)</span>&nbsp;of the London Plan (2021), policies LP12 (<span style="text-align: justify;">Meeting Housing Needs and Locations for New Homes) and LP13</span><span style="text-align: justify;">&nbsp;(Affordable Housing)&nbsp;</span>of the Hackney Local Plan&nbsp;<span style="caret-color: rgb(51, 51, 51); color: rgb(51, 51, 51);">LP33 (2020)&nbsp;</span>and the Hackney S106 Planning Contributions Supplementary Planning Document (2020).&nbsp;</p>

<p><span data-sheets-root="1" style="">The proposed development, by reason of a lack of sufficient energy efficiency measures and/or financial contribution towards carbon offsetting, would fail to achieve the maximum feasible reductions in carbon dioxide emissions, contrary to&nbsp;</span>policy SI2 (Minimising greenhouse gas emissions) of the&nbsp;London Plan (2021) and&nbsp;<span data-sheets-root="1">polices </span>LP54 (Overheating and Adapting to Climate Change) and<span data-sheets-root="1">&nbsp;LP55 (</span>Mitigating Climate Change) of the Hackney Local Plan LP33 (2020).</p>

<p>The proposed development would result in the loss of a protected tree within the De Beauvoir Conservation Area and&nbsp;encroachment into the&nbsp;Root Protection Areas of retained trees. Insufficient information has been provided to demonstrate that the development would not harm the health and longevity of trees to be retained at the site, and the proposed replacement planting is not considered sufficient to mitigate the loss of the existing tree. The proposal therefore fails to adequately protect and enhance the borough's tree stock and is contrary to policy LP51 (Tree Management and Landscaping)&nbsp;of the Hackney Local Plan 2033 (2020).</p>

<p>The proposed development, by reason of insufficient information to demonstrate that the biodiversity impacts of the development have been adequately mitigated, and in the absence of a completed legal agreement securing the delivery, management and monitoring of the proposed off-site biodiversity units necessary to achieve Biodiversity Net Gain, fails to demonstrate that the development would adequately protect and enhance biodiversity. The proposal is therefore contrary to policies LP47 (Biodiversity and Sites of Importance for Nature Conservation) and LP51 (Tree Management and Landscaping) of the Hackney Local Plan 2033 (2020).<br></p>

<p><span data-sheets-root="1" style="">The proposed development, by reason of its bulk, massing, scale, detailed design, position and location, would result in an obtrusive, unsympathetic and incompatible form of development which adversely disrupts the established grain of the area and would consequently fail to preserve or enhance the site, surrounding streetscape and wider De Beauvoir Conservation Area. As such, the proposed development is considered contrary to&nbsp;</span>policies D3 (Optimising Sity Capacity Through the Design-Led Approach), D4 (Delivering Good Design) and HC1 (Heritage Conservation and Growth) of the London Plan (2021) and policies LP1 (Design Quality and Local Character), LP3 (Designated Heritage Assets) and LP4 (Non Designated Heritage Assets) of the Hackney Local Plan 2033 (2020) and Hackney's Residential Extensions and Alterations SPD (2025).</p>

<p><span data-sheets-root="1" style="">The proposed development would result in the provision of substandard living accommodation for future occupiers due to the failure to adhere to the minimum floor-to-ceiling heights, daylight, sunlight and outlook standards,&nbsp; and cross ventilation to the detriment of the long term health and well being of future occupiers of the development, contrary to&nbsp;</span><span data-sheets-root="1">policy D6 (</span>Housing Quality and Standards) of the London Plan (2021) and policies LP2 (Development and Amenity)&nbsp;and LP17 (Housing Design)&nbsp;of the Hackney Local Plan LP33 (2020).</p>

<p><span data-sheets-root="1" style="">In the absence of a suitable undertaking to secure that the occupiers of the new residential units would not be able to apply for on street parking permit, the proposals would have an adverse impact on street parking conditions, highway safety and sustainable modes of transport, contrary to policies T1 (Strategic approach to transport) and T4 (Assessing and mitigating transport impacts) of the London Plan (2021) and&nbsp;</span>policies LP43 (Transport and Development) and LP45 (Parking and Car Free Development) of the Hackney Local Plan 2033 (2020).</p>
